name: Default
description: Box64's own values — the translator on, its usual shortcuts, the session's sound — except four: the flags kept safest (with Box64's own value the games' memcmp compares wrong, and Final Fantasy VII Remake dies at its start on the phone, 2026-10-26), the call/return shortcut off (with it, a game takes two minutes more to show its first picture on the phone, 2026-10-27), an AMD processor shown to the game, and the game's code in shared memory protected instead of checked at every run.
